notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM GALT/LITS reporting. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAinteger32BE, adapter-selected logical-time values, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies direct and periodic HLAGALT/HLALITS reflections, active-regulator and undefined-value boundaries, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MOM query/time services and FederateAmbassador joined-federate MOM reflection delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, time-management, object-management, and interaction declarations
